Categories enumerated via /categorias/{3,4,6}?page=N (server-rendered): Codigos 123, Constitucion 2, Leyes 136 = 261 unique document ids with /documentos/{id}/pdf routes. Site header advertises 125 codigos / 142 leyes; rendered listing shows 123/136 unique (delta documented, no more reachable entries across full pagination). Reglamentos category (1,516 docs) deferred to a later phase. Full HEAD sweep of all 261 on 2026-11-13: 261x HTTP 200 application/pdf, 0 over 10MB, 0 over hard byte ceiling 20971520. Batch 13/27: mor-cod-121, mor-cod-122, mor-cod-123, mor-cons-001, mor-cons-002, mor-ley-001, mor-ley-002, mor-ley-003, mor-ley-004, mor-ley-005.

rightsReview.basis: Bounded acquisition of official state legislative texts under the same documented basis as the closed programs: LFDA art. 14 frac. VIII (documented basis, not a legal conclusion). Verified 2026-11-13 before acquisition: robots.txt absent (404 HTML Not Found; absence of robots is NOT treated as permission by itself); no AI-agent or content-signal restrictions observed; no aviso legal, terms-of-use or reuse/IP prohibition located on home or category pages (absence of terms is NOT treated as express authorization by the owner); official state government library publishing direct PDF downloads (/documentos/{id}/pdf, inline); no blocks with default user agent. Scope limited to official normative texts (constitucion, codigos, leyes vigentes); quarantine only; no publication, no product activation. Stop the source if any restriction or challenge appears.
